title: Unboxing and Initial Setup
description: Your HP OMEN laptop comes carefully packaged with everything you need to get started. Follow this step-by-step guide to safely unbox and perform the initial setup.

prerequisites.title: Before You Begin
items: Ensure you have a stable Wi-Fi connection available
Have your Microsoft account credentials ready
Set aside 30-45 minutes for initial setup

steps.title: Unboxing Your OMEN
steps.content:
Carefully remove your OMEN laptop from the box and inspect all included items.

**What's in the Box:**

infoBox.title: Tip
infoBox.content: Keep all packaging materials until you're satisfied with your purchase. They may be needed if you need to return or exchange the laptop.

steps.title: Initial Power Setup
steps.content:
Before first use, charge your laptop and perform initial power configuration.
1. Connect the power adapter to your laptop and plug into wall outlet
2. Allow the laptop to charge to 100% before first boot (usually 2-3 hours)
3. Press the power button to turn on your OMEN laptop

infoBox.title: Important
infoBox.content: Don't skip the initial charging. This helps calibrate the battery and ensures optimal battery life from day one.

steps.title: Windows Setup Wizard
steps.content: Complete the Windows 11 setup process to configure your user account and preferences. Standard setup involves selecting your region, connecting to Wi-Fi, and signing in with Microsoft.

infoBox.title: Skip Network Setup (Advanced)
infoBox.content: If you prefer to set up Windows 11 without connecting to Wi-Fi initially (to create a local account), press **Shift + F10** at the network screen, type the command above, and restart.

steps.title: Initial Updates
steps.content:
After completing setup, install critical system updates.
1. Open Settings (Windows key + I)
2. Navigate to Windows Update
3. Click 'Check for updates' and install all available updates

infoBox.title: Success!
infoBox.content: Your OMEN laptop is now ready for software installation and configuration. This completes the initial unboxing and setup process.
